Message.Name: Real Time Index Message
Message.Description: The real time index message handles the real-time characteristics of an index

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: IndexLevel
Field.Description: The value of the last level for the index according to the definition provided in the IndexLevelCode (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: SessionHigh
Field.Description: Index highest level of the day (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: SessionLow
Field.Description: Index lowest level of the day (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) (not including the opening index value at the level 'A' and the average weighted index with level 'R')

Field.Name: IndIndexOpeningPortfolio
Field.Description: Indicator of the index opening portfolio W(t) (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The percentage change of the value of the packages of the instruments, for which the quotation was set to the total value of the index portfolio

Field.Name: PercentChangeTOI
Field.Description: Percentage change of TOI in relation to the value of the closing index from the previous session (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed only for messages with the level '8', '3' and '9'

Field.Name: PctChangeIndexValPrevSession
Field.Description: Percentage change of the index value in relation to the value of the closing index from the previous session (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed for messages with level '1', 'A', '2', 'C' and '5'during the index status „ZW" and „ZO". Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: PctChangeIndexValPrevYear
Field.Description: Percentage change of the index value in relation to its value at the end of the previous year (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed for messages with level '5'during the index status „ZW" and „ZO". Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: TOI
Field.Description: Theoretical opening index calculated during the index status „TO" (the field completed only for message with level '8') or during the index status „PO" (the field completed only for message with level '3' and '9')

Field.Name: PointChange
Field.Description: The point change of the index to the previous value of the index (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: ValueTrading
Field.Description: Value of trading in the instruments from the given index (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: IndexValueBid
Field.Description: The calculated value of the buy index based on the best buy offers of instruments (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed for messages with level '3', '1' and '2' till the end continuous trading phase

Field.Name: IndexValueAsk
Field.Description: The calculated value of the sell index based on the best sell offers of instruments

Field.Name: MidSpreadIndex
Field.Description: Arithmetic mean of the values of the fields: "Index value according to buy offers" and „Index value according to sell offers" (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed for messages with level '3', '1' and '2' till the end continuous trading phase

Field.Name: DifferenceCentralSpread
Field.Description: The point difference of central spread to the current value of index (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) The field is completed for messages with level '1' and '2' till the end continuous trading phase

Field.Name: NumOfActiveInstruments
Field.Description: Number of instruments – participants of the index, for which the quotation was set during the session

Field.Name: NumOfInstrOfDecreasingQt
Field.Description: The number of instruments from the index portfolio, whose quotation at the current session is lower than the reference quotation at the session on the previous day

Field.Name: NumOfInstrOfIncreasingQt
Field.Description: The number of instruments the from index portfolio, whose quotation at the current session is higher than the reference quotation at the session on the previous day

Field.Name: NumOfInstrOfUnchangedQt
Field.Description: The number of instruments from the index portfolio, whose quotation at the current session did not change as compared with the closing quotation at the session on the previous day

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: LevelScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with values of the following fields : IndexLevel SessionHigh, SessionLow, IndIndexOpeningPortfolio, PercentChangeTOI, PctChangeIndexValPrevSession, PctChangeIndexValPrevYear, TOI, PointChange, ValueTrading, IndexValueBid, IndexValueAsk, MidSpreadIndex, DifferenceCentralSpread

Field.Name: TimeFirstHigh
Field.Description: The time at which the highest value of a given index was published for the first time

Field.Name: TimeFirstLow
Field.Description: The time at which the lowest value of a given index was published for the first time

Field.Name: IndexStatusIndicator
Field.Description: Two letter marker informing about the index status at the time of publishing the message

Field.Name: IndexLevelCode
Field.Description: Index Level Code

Field.Name: MarkerPercentChangeTOI
Field.Description: Marker for the percentage change of TOI in relation to the value of the closing index from the previous session

Field.Name: MarkerPctChgIndexValPrevSess
Field.Description: The indicator for the point change of the current value of the index as compared with the previous index value

Field.Name: MarkerPctChgIndexValPrevYear
Field.Description: Marker for the percentage change of the index value in relation to its value at the end of the previous year

Field.Name: MarkerPointChange
Field.Description: Marker for the point change of the index to the current value of the index

Field.Name: MarkerDifferenceCentralSpread
Field.Description: The marker for the point change between the central spread and the last published index value

Field.Name: DisseminationFrequencyMarker
Field.Description: One letter marker determining, whether the information on index value will be published in the next message at a particular level

Message.Name: Index Summary Message
Message.Description: The index summary message provides a summary of the data calculated in a stock index for a given day

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: ClosingIndexValue
Field.Description: Closing index value (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: IndOpeningPortfolio
Field.Description: Indicator of the opening of the index portfolio W(t) for closing index

Field.Name: OpeningIndexValue
Field.Description: Opening index value (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: SessionHigh
Field.Description: Highest level of the day (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: SessionLow
Field.Description: Lowest level of the day (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) It does not include the index values calculated according to synthetic formula from levels A, B and C from message 546

Field.Name: PctChgHighIndexValPrevSession
Field.Description: Percentage change of the highest index value to the value of the closing index from the previous session (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: PctChgLowIndexValPrevSession
Field.Description: Percentage change of the lowest index value to the value of the closing index from the previous session (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: PctChangeIndexValPrevSession
Field.Description: Percentage change of the closing index value in relation to the value of the closing index from the previous session (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: PctChangeIndexValPrevYear
Field.Description: Percentage change of the index value in relation to its value at the end of the previous year (To be calculated with the LevelScaleCode) Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: CapitalisationPortfolio
Field.Description: Capitalisation of the portfolio for the closing index expressed in the currency of the index, on basis of which the closing index is calculated

Field.Name: IndexAdjustmentCoefficient
Field.Description: Index adjustment coefficient K(t) for the closing index (To be combined with IndexAdjustmentScaleCode)

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: LevelScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with Indices values (ClosingIndexValue, IndOpeningPortfolio, OpeningIndexValue, SessionHigh, SessionLow, PctChgHighIndexValPrevSession, PctChgLowIndexValPrevSession, PctChangeIndexValPrevSession, PctChangeIndexValPrevYear)

Field.Name: CapitalisationScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with CapitalisationPortfolio Not used for strategy index (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "M")

Field.Name: IndexAdjustmentScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with IndexAdjustmentCoefficient

Field.Name: TimeClosing
Field.Description: Time of the publication of the closing value of the index at a given session.. Format HHMMSS. Time use CET

Field.Name: TimeOpening
Field.Description: Time of the publication of the opening value of the index

Field.Name: TimeFullOpening
Field.Description: Time of the publication of the full opening value of the index portfolio for W(t) = 100%. The time of sending the message 546 with level 'B' Format HHMMSS or zero in case the indicator W(t) has not reached 100%. Time use CET

Field.Name: TimeHigh
Field.Description: Time of the publication of the highest value of the index

Field.Name: TimeLow
Field.Description: Time of the publication of the lowest value of the index

Field.Name: MarkerHigh
Field.Description: Marker of the percentage change of the highest value of the index to the closing index value from the previous session

Field.Name: MarkerLow
Field.Description: Marker of the percentage change of the lowest value of the index to the closing index value from the previous session

Field.Name: MarkerClosingPrevSession
Field.Description: Marker of the percentage change of the index at a particular session to the closing index value from the previous session

Field.Name: MarkerClosingPrevYear
Field.Description: Marker of the percentage change of the closing value of the index to its value at the end of the previous year

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the index itself

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: IndexAdjustmentCoefficient
Field.Description: Index adjustment coefficient K(t) for the index (To be combined with IndexAdjustmentScaleCode) The algorithm of setting its value is provided in the WSE Index Resolution, NewConnect Index Resolution, RESPECT Index Resolution and TBSPIndex Regulations For strategy indices (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "S" or "L") the field is filled in with value zero

Field.Name: LevelCashPortfolio
Field.Description: Level in cash in portfolio For strategy indices (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "S" or "L") the field is filled in with value of interbank reference rate adopted in the index calculation algorithm

Field.Name: ValueLastClosingIndex
Field.Description: Value of the last closing index / NAV value number of ETF units (To be combined with LevelScaleCode)

Field.Name: NumberOfComponents
Field.Description: Total number of instruments in the index / given product For strategy indices (in 548 message the field ProductClassification filled in with value "S" or "L") the field is filled in with number of days between current and previous session

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: IndexAdjustmentScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with IndexAdjustmentCoefficient

Field.Name: CashPortfolioScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with LevelCashPortfolio

Field.Name: LevelScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with ValueLastClosingIndex

Field.Name: IndexPortfolioComponent
Field.Description: Characteristics of index portfolio / information product; block is repeated 20 times

Field.Name: DateValidity
Field.Description: Date of validity of index portfolio / information product (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: IndexCurrency
Field.Description: Index currency / information product currency

Field.Name: IndexStatusIndicator
Field.Description: Index Status Indicator

Field.Name: IndexPresSeq
Field.Description: Index presentation sequence marker For other information product the field :filler

Field.Name: ModeIndexDissemination
Field.Description: Mode of index dissemination

Field.Name: ProductClassification
Field.Description: Information product classification

Field.Name: OpeningCalcFormula
Field.Description: Opening index calculation formula

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: TOIDissemination
Field.Description: TOI dissemination marker during TO index status

Field.Name: SpreadDissemination
Field.Description: Spread dissemination marker

Field.Name: TradingValuePublication
Field.Description: Trading value publication marker

Field.Name: MessageContinuation
Field.Description: Message Continuation Marker

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Group.Name: IndexPortfolioComponent
Group.Description: Characteristics of index portfolio / information product; block is repeated 20 times

Field.Name: InstrumentISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code of the instrument

Field.Name: InstrumentAbbrevName
Field.Description: Abbreviated name of the instrument

Field.Name: InstrumentPacket
Field.Description: Instrument packet in index portfolio / of information product
